basic_info.description: Located near Lincoln Park Golf Course, Playground and the renovated Golden Gate National Recreation Area, this charming Spanish Mediterranean Revival home offers storybook curb appeal, modern updates and vintage details. The light-filled living room with high vaulted ceiling, delicately arched windows, wood burning fireplace and Juliet balcony opens to a formal dining room. The updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances wraps the sunny center patio. Two spacious bedrooms and a split bath with tub and shower complete the main level. An interior staircase leads to the garage level with an  expansive bedroom/lounge, powder room and laundry that opens to the backyard. Elegant period details include: hardwood floors, vaulted ceiling, crown molding and rich wood trims. Updates include: 200 amp main panel, interior electrical wiring,  dual-pane windows at rear, seismic retrofit work and new heater + vents. Voluminous 3-car garage with tall ceilings (possibly room for expansion) and  storage. Deep lot w/mature trees perfect for entertaining or creating your dream garden. Located near Golf course, playground, Clement St shops, cafes, parks, public transit and Ocean Beach!
